gold_facts.text: When the parents marry, the rules for a child born during the marriage apply by analogy to a child born before the marriage, once the husband's paternity is established by recognition or by judgment.
The recognition can be challenged by the mother, by the husband, and by the husband's commune of origin or domicile.

The child (or after its death its descendants) can challenge the recognition if the spouses' life together ended while the child was a minor or if the recognition took place after the child turned 12.

competing_candidates: The general rule on challenging a recognition of paternity (any interested person may challenge) also bears on who can contest; the question is narrowed to parents who married after the recognition.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported in de/fr/it: 'Die Anerkennung kann angefochten werden: 1. von der Mutter'. All 3 facts match Abs 1-2. 210:260a lists challengers more broadly (any interested person) but the married-after-recognition setting points to 259. No lexical copy (de 356).

question: Unsere Tochter kam zur Welt, bevor wir geheiratet haben. Mein Mann hat schon vor der Hochzeit offiziell erklärt, dass er der Vater ist, danach haben wir geheiratet. Wird sie jetzt rechtlich wie ein in der Ehe geborenes Kind behandelt, und wer könnte die Vatererklärung meines Mannes später noch angreifen?

gold_facts.text: The deceased can conclude with an heir a contract by which the heir waives the inheritance, with or without consideration.
The person who waived is not considered an heir when the succession opens.
Unless the contract provides otherwise, the waiver also has effect against the descendants of the person who waived.

competing_candidates: Neighbouring rules on a waiver made in favour of specific co-heirs and on the rights of the waiving heir's creditors touch the same contract but not the effect on descendants.
provenance.critic_notes: 'wirkt der Erbverzicht auch gegenüber den Nachkommen des Verzichtenden' (de); fr 'opposable aux descendants du renonçant'. Facts supported. Neighbours 210:496/497 do not answer the descendants point. Natural, no copy (fr 897).

question: Mon père me propose de renoncer dès maintenant à ma part de sa succession en échange d'une somme d'argent versée tout de suite. Si j'accepte et qu'il décède plus tard, est-ce que mes propres enfants pourront hériter à ma place ?

gold_facts.text: A person who finds a lost animal must notify the owner and, if the owner is unknown, report the find.
The cantons designate the office to which the find of an animal must be reported.

The duty to notify and report for animals is subject to the rule that a person who finds something in an inhabited house or in a facility serving public use or traffic must hand it over to the master of the house, the tenant or the persons in charge of supervision.

competing_candidates: Later rules on finders (keeping the find, reward, acquisition of ownership after a waiting period) address what happens afterwards, not the initial duties.
provenance.critic_notes: 720a: 'unter Vorbehalt von Artikel 720 Absatz 3'; 720 Abs 3: find in a 'dem öffentlichen Gebrauch oder Verkehr dienenden Anstalt' must be handed over. Second article truly needed for the station. 210:721/722 (custody, reward) are later steps. No lexical signal.
provenance.writer_note: A expressly reserves the hand-over rule for finds in houses or public facilities from B; the station setting makes both needed.

question: I found a lost dog wandering around inside a busy public train station building. I don't know who it belongs to. What am I legally required to do with it, and who do I hand it over or report it to?

gold_facts.text: Creditors of an heir who held loss certificates at the time of the succession may demand reduction if the deceased exceeded the disposable portion to the heir's detriment and the heir, at their request, does not bring the reduction action.
The creditors must act within the time limit that applies to the heir.
They may demand reduction only to the extent needed to cover their claims.

competing_candidates: Civil Code rule letting creditors challenge an heir's renunciation of the inheritance (different situation: here the heir accepts but does not sue)
Civil Code articles on the reduction action itself and its time limits
provenance.critic_notes: 'Gläubiger die zur Zeit des Erbganges Verlustscheine besitzen ... innerhalb der dem Erben gegebenen Frist' (de). All facts supported in 3 langs. Question paraphrases loss certificate well; it rank 49. No competing article answers creditor standing.
provenance.writer_note: Question states the loss certificate predates the death and that the heir was asked and refused, to match the article's conditions.

question: Già prima che suo padre morisse avevo un documento dell'ufficio esecuzioni che certifica la mia perdita verso mio cugino. Col testamento il padre ha lasciato quasi tutto alla sorella e mio cugino riceve meno di quanto la legge gli garantisce, ma pur sollecitato non vuole contestarlo. Posso agire io al suo posto, entro quale termine e fino a che punto?

gold_facts.text: Additional contributions are called in by the managing directors.

They are only due when capital and legal reserves are no longer covered, when the company cannot properly continue its business without them, or when it needs equity for a reason set out in the articles of association.
The opening of bankruptcy makes all outstanding additional contributions due.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring GmbH article that introduces the obligation to make additional contributions in the articles of association (it sets up the duty and a cap, not when the money becomes due).
provenance.critic_notes: 'Sie dürfen nur eingefordert werden, wenn' 3 cases; Abs 3 bankruptcy. Facts supported in 3 langs. GmbH named, so cooperative rule 220:871 is distinguished. fr 145.

question: I'm a member of a limited liability company (GmbH) whose articles oblige members to pay in extra money on top of their capital share. The managing directors now want that extra money from us. In which situations can they actually demand it, and what happens to the unpaid amounts if the company goes bankrupt?

gold_facts.text: No additional period for performance needs to be set if the debtor's conduct shows that it would be useless.
No additional period is needed if, because of the debtor's delay, the performance has become useless to the creditor.
No additional period is needed if the contract shows that the parties intended performance to take place exactly at or by a specific time.

competing_candidates: The preceding general-part article on the creditor's options after setting a deadline (it states the rights, while A states when the deadline can be skipped).
The sales-law rule on fixed-date commercial sales, which presumes withdrawal when delivery is late; the question concerns a private custom order, not a commercial sale.
provenance.critic_notes: Ziff 3: 'Leistung genau zu einer bestimmten oder bis zu einer bestimmten Zeit erfolgen soll'. Facts match all three cases. Contract-for-work rule 220:366 concerns delay before the deadline; 220:190 is commercial sale. de 1866, good control item.

question: Ich habe bei einem Schneider ein Kleid für meine Hochzeit bestellt, fest vereinbart auf den Tag vor der Feier. Er hat es nicht rechtzeitig fertig. Muss ich ihm trotzdem zuerst noch etwas zusätzliche Zeit geben, bevor ich vom Vertrag Abstand nehmen kann, oder in welchen Fällen ist das unnötig?

gold_facts.text: A transaction coupled with the lease of residential or commercial premises is void if the conclusion or continuation of the lease is made dependent on it.
This applies where the tenant thereby takes on an obligation towards the landlord or a third party that is not directly connected with the use of the leased property.

provenance.critic_notes: 'Ein Koppelungsgeschäft ... ist nichtig, wenn der Abschluss ... davon abhängig gemacht wird'. Facts supported in 3 langs. No other article on coupled transactions. fr 332.

question: Je veux louer un appartement, mais le propriétaire me dit qu'il ne me donnera le bail que si je signe aussi un contrat d'assurance ménage auprès de l'agence de son frère, et que je devrai le garder tant que j'habite là. Cet engagement supplémentaire est-il valable?

gold_facts.text: The rank of secured (pledge) bondholders cannot be changed without their consent.
That protection of rank is subject to the reserved power of the bondholders' community to grant priority to a new pledge.
Granting priority to a pledge created for new capital brought into the enterprise requires the consent of representatives of at least two thirds of the outstanding capital.

competing_candidates: Neighbouring Code of Obligations articles on bondholder communities: approval of such resolutions by the competent authority, and the rule for several bondholder communities
provenance.critic_notes: 1174 Abs 2 'Vorbehalten bleibt Artikel 1170 Ziffer 7'; 1170 'zwei Dritteln des im Umlauf befindlichen Kapitals'. Both needed. Gold omits that such decisions bind dissenters only after approval by the cantonal authority (220:1176); question asks only majority, so acceptable.

gold_facts.text: The rank of secured (pledge) bondholders cannot be changed without their consent.
That protection of rank is subject to the reserved power of the bondholders' community to grant priority to a new pledge.
Granting priority to a pledge created for new capital brought into the enterprise requires the consent of representatives of at least two thirds of the outstanding capital.

pre_revision.question: Possiedo obbligazioni di un prestito emesso da una società, con una garanzia reale a favore di noi creditori. L'impresa è in difficoltà e la maggioranza dei titolari vuole permettere che un nuovo finanziatore riceva una garanzia che passi davanti alla nostra. Possono deciderlo anche se io sono contrario, e quale maggioranza serve?

provenance.writer_note: Answer combines the rank-protection exception in A with the two-thirds quorum and the listed measure in B.

question: Possiedo obbligazioni garantite da un pegno. L'impresa emittente è in difficoltà e i titolari vogliono dare a un nuovo finanziatore, che porta capitale fresco, una garanzia che passi davanti alla nostra. Di regola la nostra posizione può essere peggiorata senza il consenso di ciascuno di noi? Quale quota del capitale deve approvare?

gold_facts.text: Several debtors are jointly and severally liable when they declare that each of them is liable to the creditor for the whole debt.
Without such a declaration, joint and several liability exists only in the cases provided for by law.

competing_candidates: The following article on the effects of joint and several liability (the creditor may claim the whole from any debtor) presupposes that such liability exists; it does not say when it arises.
provenance.critic_notes: 'Ohne solche Willenserklärung entsteht Solidarität nur in den vom Gesetze bestimmten Fällen.' Supported. Answer is general; a system might cite 220:544 Abs 3 (partners jointly bound) as a statutory case, which is consistent with gold. it 61.

question: Io e due amici abbiamo firmato insieme un contratto per un prestito, ma nel testo non c'è scritto che ognuno di noi debba rispondere per tutto l'importo. In quali casi il creditore può comunque pretendere da uno solo di noi l'intera somma?

gold_facts.text: Employer and employee may terminate the employment relationship immediately at any time for valid reasons, and on request the immediate termination must be justified in writing.
A valid reason is any circumstance that makes it unreasonable, in good faith, to expect the terminating party to continue the contract.
The court may never treat the fact that the employee was prevented from working through no fault of his own as a valid reason.

competing_candidates: The article protecting employees against ordinary dismissal during illness (protection periods) concerns ordinary notice, not immediate termination.
The article on the consequences of unjustified immediate dismissal (compensation) is a follow-up remedy, not asked here.
provenance.critic_notes: Abs 3: 'darf aber in keinem Fall die unverschuldete Verhinderung ... als wichtigen Grund anerkennen'; Abs 1 written reasons on request. Facts supported in 3 langs. 220:336c concerns ordinary notice. No lexical copy.

question: My employer fired me on the spot, without any notice period, after I had been off work for several weeks because of an illness that was not my fault. Can being unable to work count as a reason to let someone go immediately, and can I insist that he tells me in writing why he did it?

gold_facts.text: The members' liability and their obligation to make additional contributions in a cooperative can only be changed by amending the articles of association.

A reduction of the liability of the members or of their obligation to make additional contributions does not affect debts that arose before the amendment of the articles was published (registered, in the Italian text).

provenance.critic_notes: Fact 2 now covers publication (de/fr) vs iscrizione (it). de: 'vor der Veröffentlichung der Statutenrevision entstandenen Verbindlichkeiten nicht betroffen'. Abs 1 Statutenrevision answers 'wie'. Cooperative-only; de 27.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact 2 worded to hold in all three language versions.

question: Bei unserer Genossenschaft haften die Mitglieder bisher persönlich für die Schulden. Jetzt soll diese Haftung abgeschafft werden. Wie geht das, und müssen wir für Schulden, die schon vor der Änderung bestanden, weiterhin geradestehen?

gold_facts.text: A person who voluntarily pays a debt that is not owed can recover the payment only if he proves that he was mistaken about owing it.
Recovery is excluded if the payment was made for a time-barred debt or in fulfilment of a moral obligation.

competing_candidates: The general unjust enrichment article (duty to return an unjustified gain) is the broader basis; A sets the specific mistake requirement for paying a non-debt.
The debt enforcement act's action to recover a payment made under enforcement; excluded by stating no enforcement took place.
provenance.critic_notes: 'nur dann zurückfordern, wenn er nachzuweisen vermag, dass er sich ... im Irrtum befunden hat'; Abs 2 time-barred debt. fr 1 from payé, dette, devais, but phrasing is paraphrased (plein gré, temps écoulé). Abs 3 SchKG excluded by question. 220:62 is the general basis.

question: J'ai payé de mon plein gré une facture alors qu'en réalité je ne devais rien, sans qu'aucune poursuite n'ait été engagée contre moi. Puis-je récupérer cet argent, à quelle condition, et est-ce différent si j'ai payé une vieille dette que le créancier ne pouvait plus exiger à cause du temps écoulé?

gold_facts.text: Unless the law or the articles of association provide otherwise, the general meeting of a company limited by shares passes resolutions and holds elections by a majority of the share votes represented.
The articles of association may provide that the chair has the casting vote in the event of a tie.

competing_candidates: The next article listing important resolutions that need a qualified majority (an exception to the default rule, not asked here).
Parallel majority rules for the GmbH members' meeting and the cooperative general assembly; excluded by naming the company limited by shares.
provenance.critic_notes: 'mit der Mehrheit der vertretenen Aktienstimmen'; Abs 2 Stichentscheid if articles provide. Twins 220:808 (GmbH) and 220:888 (cooperative) distinguished by società anonima / azionisti. it 3 from common words (maggioranza, parità).

question: All'assemblea degli azionisti della nostra società anonima, su una proposta i voti favorevoli e contrari sono stati esattamente uguali. Che maggioranza serve normalmente per approvare una decisione, e chi decide in caso di parità?

gold_facts.text: The compensation report must state outstanding loans and credits granted to current members of the board of directors, the executive board and the advisory board.
It must also state outstanding loans and credits granted to former members of these bodies on terms that are not customary in the market.
For the board of directors, the report gives the total amount and the amount for each member, with the member's name and function.
For the executive board, the report gives the total amount and the highest amount for a single member, with that member's name and function.

provenance.critic_notes: 734b Abs 2 'gilt Artikel 734a Absatz 3 sinngemäss'; 734a Abs 3 Ziff 1-2 per-member board amounts and highest executive amount, with names. Second article needed. Former CEO on non-market terms fits 734b Ziff 2. de 435.
provenance.writer_note: A says the compensation disclosure detail rules of B apply to loans and credits by analogy; facts 3 and 4 state those rules from B.

question: A company whose shares trade on the stock exchange lent money to two of its current directors and also, at an unusually low interest rate, to a former CEO. The loans have not been repaid. What does the company have to disclose about these loans in its yearly report on executive pay, and does it have to name the individual people and amounts?

gold_facts.text: A person who runs a business alone must use his surname, with or without first names, as the essential element of the business name.
If the business name contains other surnames, the owner's surname must be made prominent.
The business name must not contain any addition suggesting the existence of a partnership or company.

competing_candidates: The general article on business name formation (truthfulness, no misleading content) overlaps on the '& Partners' point but does not set the surname requirement.
provenance.critic_notes: 'muss den wesentlichen Inhalt seiner Firma aus dem Familiennamen ... bilden'; Abs 3 no partnership addition. Facts supported in 3 langs. 220:944 (general business-name rules) partially overlaps on the Partners point only. No lexical signal.

question: I run a carpentry business on my own, with no partners, and I'd like to register it as 'Woodline & Partners'. What does the business name legally have to contain, and am I allowed to add something like '& Partners'?

gold_facts.text: A non-competition clause must be reasonably limited in place, time and type of business so that it does not unfairly endanger the employee's economic future.
It may exceed three years only in special circumstances.
The court may reduce an excessive prohibition at its discretion, taking account of all circumstances and fairly considering any consideration paid by the employer.

competing_candidates: The preceding article on the prerequisites for a valid non-competition clause (written form, insight into customers or secrets) covers validity, not its limits.
provenance.critic_notes: 'es darf nur unter besonderen Umständen drei Jahre überschreiten'; Abs 2 court may reduce. de 1 is driven by Verbot/Konkurrenz, the natural lay terms; not a copy. 220:340 (validity) and 340c (lapse) do not answer limits.

question: In meinem Arbeitsvertrag steht, dass ich nach meinem Austritt fünf Jahre lang in der ganzen Schweiz nicht für ein Konkurrenzunternehmen arbeiten darf. Wie weit darf so ein Verbot gehen, und kann ein Gericht es abschwächen, wenn es zu streng ist?

gold_facts.text: Board members and all persons involved in management or liquidation are liable to the company and to individual shareholders and creditors for damage caused by an intentional or negligent breach of their duties.

A person who lawfully delegates a task to another body is liable for damage caused by that body unless he proves that he exercised the care required by the circumstances in selecting, instructing and supervising it.

competing_candidates: Stock company articles on a shareholder's claim for damage suffered by the company and on joint and several liability of several liable persons
Parallel liability rules for cooperatives and limited liability companies (excluded by stating a stock company)
provenance.critic_notes: Abs 2: 'Wer die Erfüllung einer Aufgabe befugterweise einem anderen Organ überträgt, haftet' unless due care. fr 1 from délégué, dommage, responsables, natural terms. Cooperative 220:916 lacks the delegation clause; SA named.
provenance.writer_note: Question asks only whether liability survives delegation, not who may sue or how damages are shared.

question: Je suis actionnaire d'une petite société anonyme. Le conseil d'administration a confié la gestion courante à un directeur externe, qui a ensuite conclu des affaires désastreuses pour la société. Les administrateurs peuvent-ils dire que ce n'est pas leur faute puisqu'ils avaient délégué cette tâche, ou restent-ils responsables du dommage ?

gold_facts.text: The customer may revoke his offer or acceptance if he was approached at his workplace, in residential premises or their immediate surroundings.
The same applies if he was approached on public transport or on a public road, or at a promotional event linked to an excursion or similar occasion.
The same applies if he was approached by telephone or a similar means of simultaneous voice communication.

competing_candidates: The preceding article on the scope of the revocation right (consumer purposes, professional supplier, minimum amount) and the following article on exceptions (customer requested the talks, market stall) bear on whether the right applies; the question asks only which situations give the right, and states the talks were not requested.
provenance.critic_notes: 'wenn ihm das Angebot gemacht wurde: ... in öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder auf öffentlichen Strassen' (de); four situations in 3 langs. 40a (scope) and 40c (exceptions) are neighbours; question asks only situations. de 85.

question: Un venditore mi ha fermato alla stazione, senza che io avessi chiesto nulla, e mi ha convinto a firmare un contratto. Mi chiedo in quali situazioni di questo tipo, cioè quando qualcuno mi propone un acquisto fuori da un negozio, la legge mi permette di tornare sui miei passi.

gold_facts.text: A company limited by shares is dissolved by a court judgment if shareholders together representing at least 10 percent of the share capital or of the votes request dissolution for good cause.
In such an action, the court may order another appropriate solution acceptable to the parties instead of dissolution.

competing_candidates: The parallel dissolution-for-good-cause rule for the GmbH; excluded by naming the company limited by shares.
provenance.critic_notes: Ziff 4: 'Aktionäre, die zusammen mindestens 10 Prozent ... aus wichtigen Gründen'; Abs 2 other solution. 12% fits. GmbH twin 220:821 Abs 3 (any member may sue) distinguished by company limited by shares. No lexical signal.

question: Together with two other shareholders I hold 12% of a company limited by shares, and the majority shareholder keeps running it against our interests. Can we ask a court to wind up the company, and is the court obliged to dissolve it if it finds our reasons serious?

gold_facts.text: The revocation period is 14 days and starts when the customer has proposed or accepted the contract and has received the required information about the revocation right.
The period is respected if the customer notifies the revocation to the supplier or hands the revocation declaration to the post office on the last day of the period.
The supplier must inform the customer, in writing or in another form allowing proof by text, of the right of revocation, its form and time limit, and give its address.
This information must be dated and allow the contract to be identified.

provenance.critic_notes: 40e 'Die Widerrufsfrist beträgt 14 Tage'; Abs 4 post on last day; 40d info duty. Both articles needed (40e refers to 40d). Facts supported in 3 langs. de 11.

question: Ein Vertreter hat mich zu Hause besucht und ich habe einen Vertrag unterschrieben, den ich jetzt rückgängig machen möchte. Wie viel Zeit habe ich dafür, ab wann zählt diese Zeit, reicht es, wenn ich meine Erklärung am letzten Tag zur Post bringe, und was hätte mir die Firma dazu schriftlich mitteilen müssen?

gold_facts.text: Expenses and income must be separated from each other in time and in substance.
If net proceeds from sales of goods and services or financial income do not exceed 100,000 francs, the time-based separation may be dropped and expenditure and receipts used instead.

competing_candidates: Code of Obligations rule allowing small sole proprietorships and partnerships to keep only simple income-and-expenditure accounts (excluded by making the business a limited liability company)
provenance.critic_notes: Abs 2: 'Nettoerlöse ... oder die Finanzerträge 100 000 Franken nicht überschreiten'. Facts supported. de 2 from Franken, Einnahmen, Jahr in a control item; technical term Abgrenzung avoided. 220:957 simple bookkeeping excluded by GmbH.
provenance.writer_note: Same-language control item; avoids the article's technical terms.

question: Unsere kleine GmbH macht pro Jahr nur etwa 60'000 Franken Umsatz und hat keine Einnahmen aus Geldanlagen. Dürfen wir im Jahresabschluss einfach die tatsächlich bezahlten und eingegangenen Beträge verbuchen, statt Rechnungen und Kosten dem Jahr zuzuordnen, in das sie wirtschaftlich gehören?

gold_facts.text: A fixed-term employment contract ends without notice of termination being required.
If a fixed-term contract is tacitly continued after the agreed period, it is deemed to be a contract of indefinite duration.

competing_candidates: The parallel tenancy rule on tacit continuation of a fixed-term lease; excluded by the employment context.
provenance.critic_notes: 'Ein befristetes Arbeitsverhältnis endigt ohne Kündigung'; Abs 2 tacit continuation. Lease twin 220:266 has the same rule; the employment context separates them. fr 63 control.

question: Mon contrat de travail était conclu pour une année seulement. Dois-je envoyer une lettre de démission pour qu'il s'arrête à la date prévue? Et si, à l'échéance, personne ne dit rien et je continue simplement à travailler, quel est mon statut?

gold_facts.text: Companies subject to ordinary audit that are active, directly or through a controlled company, in the extraction of minerals, oil or natural gas or in harvesting primary forests must report annually on payments to state bodies.
If the company must prepare consolidated accounts, it must prepare a consolidated report on payments, which replaces the reports of the individual group companies.
State bodies are national, regional or municipal authorities of a third country, including administrations and companies controlled by them.

competing_candidates: The following articles on the content of the payment report (types of payments, amount thresholds) and its publication; they do not set the reporting obligation itself.
provenance.critic_notes: Abs 1 'zu einer ordentlichen Revision verpflichtet ... durch ein von ihnen kontrolliertes Unternehmen'; Abs 2 Konzernzahlungsbericht; Abs 5 state bodies. revisione ordinaria and consolidato echo the text but it 5 in a control item. Abs 3 (inclusion in foreign group report) not in gold; fine.

question: La nostra società svizzera, soggetta a revisione ordinaria, estrae rame in Africa tramite una filiale che controlla. Siamo obbligati a rendere conto dei soldi che versiamo ai governi e alle autorità locali di quei Paesi? E se il gruppo prepara un bilancio consolidato, ogni società deve fare un proprio rapporto?

gold_facts.text: If someone manages another person's affairs not in that person's interest, the principal is still entitled to appropriate the benefits arising from the management of his affairs.
The principal must reimburse and release the person who managed the affairs only to the extent that he is enriched.

competing_candidates: The general unjust enrichment rules and tort liability could also be invoked by the owner, but the specific rule on agency in the agent's own interest is A.
provenance.critic_notes: 'gleichwohl berechtigt, die ... Vorteile sich anzueignen'; Abs 2 'nur so weit ..., als er bereichert ist'. Purely to make money for himself signals 423. 210:940 (bad-faith possessor: fruits, necessary expenses) could be cited with a different expense rule; see s-0017. No lexical signal.

question: While I was abroad for a year, my neighbour rented out my empty holiday flat to tourists without asking me, purely to make money for himself. Can I claim the rent he collected, and do I have to pay him back for the cleaning and advertising costs he had?

gold_facts.text: An agent is liable, as if they were his own, for the acts of a person to whom he improperly delegated the mandate.
The principal may directly assert against the sub-agent the rights the agent has against that person.

competing_candidates: The preceding mandate article on the duty to perform personally (when delegation is permitted) and the general rule on liability for auxiliary persons; neither gives the principal's direct claim against the substitute.
provenance.critic_notes: 'haftet er für dessen Handlungen, wie wenn es seine eigenen wären'; Abs 3 direct claim against the third party. Facts supported in 3 langs. 220:398 (personal performance) and 220:101 (auxiliaries) lack the direct claim. de 347.

gold_facts.text: An agent is liable, as if they were his own, for the acts of a person to whom he improperly delegated the mandate.
If the agent was authorised to delegate, he is liable only for due care in choosing and instructing the sub-agent.
In both cases the principal may directly assert against the sub-agent the rights the agent has against that person.

pre_revision.question: Ich habe ein Treuhandbüro mit meiner Steuererklärung beauftragt. Ohne mich zu fragen und ohne dass ich das erlaubt hatte, hat es die Arbeit an ein anderes Büro weitergegeben, das einen teuren Fehler gemacht hat. Haftet mein Treuhänder dafür so, als hätte er selbst den Fehler gemacht, und kann ich mich auch direkt an das andere Büro wenden?

question: Ich habe ein Treuhandbüro mit meiner Steuererklärung beauftragt. Ohne mich zu fragen und ohne dass ich das erlaubt hatte, hat es die Arbeit an ein anderes Büro weitergegeben, das einen teuren Fehler gemacht hat. Haftet mein Treuhänder dafür so, als hätte er selbst den Fehler gemacht, und kann ich mich auch direkt an das andere Büro wenden?

gold_facts.text: The maker of a promissory note payable at a fixed time after sight must confirm the sight on the note, stating the date and signing it.
If the maker refuses to confirm the sight with a date, this must be established by a protest, and the period after sight then runs from the date of the protest.
Where the dated statement is missing, the holder must have the omission established in time by a protest to preserve his rights of recourse against the endorsers and the drawer.

competing_candidates: The bill of exchange article on presentation periods for sight bills (the masked 'another article' in A) sets the time limit for presentation, not asked here.
provenance.critic_notes: 1099: 'Weigert sich der Aussteller ... durch einen Protest festzustellen (Art. 1015); ... vom Tage des Protestes'. 1015 Abs 2 gives the recourse-preservation rule; both needed. fr 3 from unavoidable terms (billet à ordre, souscripteur). Writer note mentions a fact 4 that does not exist; harmless.
provenance.writer_note: B is the acceptance-form rule for bills of exchange, which A invokes for the protest; fact 4 states B's rule as written.

question: J'ai reçu un billet à ordre payable trente jours après que le souscripteur l'aura vu. Je le lui ai présenté, mais il refuse d'y inscrire la date à laquelle il l'a vu. gold_facts.text: The general meeting may create conditional capital by granting shareholders, holders of bonds or similar debt instruments, employees, board members of the company or group companies, or third parties the right to acquire new shares.
